title: DataNest connections
description: Connections shared through a project's .vscode/datanest.json, or a list exported from DataNest. It never holds passwords: each person keeps theirs in the editor's secret storage.

folders.description: Folder order of an exported list.

id.description: Names this server's password or passphrase on each computer. Filled in by position when left out.

auth.description: How to log in. Passwords and passphrases are never kept in this file.

keyFile.description: Private key file, for "key". `~` is your home folder.

agentSocket.description: SSH agent socket, Windows pipe or `pageant`, for "agent". Empty means the usual place.

id.description: A short id that stays when the name changes: each person's password for this connection is found by it. Made from the name when left out.

driver.description: mysql also covers MariaDB; mssql is Microsoft SQL Server; redis runs Redis commands, not SQL.

database.description: Database name; for redis the number of the database, 0 when left out.

file.description: SQLite database file. A relative path starts at the workspace folder.

id.description: Names this server's password or passphrase on each computer. Filled in by position when left out.

auth.description: How to log in. Passwords and passphrases are never kept in this file.

keyFile.description: Private key file, for "key". `~` is your home folder.

agentSocket.description: SSH agent socket, Windows pipe or `pageant`, for "agent". Empty means the usual place.

jumps.description: Servers to pass through first, in order (like ProxyJump).

ssh.description: Reach the database through an SSH tunnel.

ca.description: CA certificate file; relative paths start at the workspace folder.

folder.description: Folder in the tree (exported lists only; a project is a folder of its own).

production.description: Stands out, and every change is confirmed first.

readOnly.description: Changes are refused, and the session itself is opened read-only.

options.description: How sessions are opened and kept. Everything left out keeps DataNest's default.

connectTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server and each SSH hop when connecting.

queryTimeout.description: Seconds a statement may run; overrides the datanest.queryTimeout setting, 0 means no limit.

keepAlive.description: Seconds of quiet after which an idle session sends SELECT 1 (PING for redis); 0 or left out: never.

initSql.description: Statements every new session runs first, e.g. SET search_path = app. For redis: commands, one per line, e.g. CLIENT SETNAME app.

timeZone.description: Session time zone: UTC, +03:00 or a name the server knows (MySQL and PostgreSQL).

charset.description: MySQL character set of the session; utf8mb4 when left out.

filter.description: Which databases and schemas the tree and the object search show. Patterns: * any characters, ? one, a leading ! hides.

schemas.description: Schemas of every database (PostgreSQL); left out: all.

redis.description: How a redis connection finds its server; left out: one server at host:port.

mode.description: sentinel: host:port is a Sentinel (port 26379 when left out); cluster: host:port is one node of the cluster.

masterName.description: The name of the master the Sentinels watch, for sentinel.

nodes.description: More Sentinels or cluster nodes, tried when the first does not answer.

sentinelUser.description: The ACL user of the Sentinels, when they ask for one. Their password is never kept in this file.
